self: Use case: game-asset. Asset type: ONE standalone transparent PNG GPS map marker sprite for a sunny pixel-art outdoor cat-and-mouse game. Subject: SELF / YOU marker, a single cheerful sky-blue pixel map pin, thick squared-off dark pine outline and thin warm-ivory outer keyline for contrast, a very simple ivory paw print centered inside the blue head. Small stepped pointed location tip at the bottom center. Style: original handcrafted cozy 16-bit farming-adventure inventory/map sprite, Stardew-Valley-like warm readable pixel craft with a hint of Minecraft block clarity, not a copied game asset. Front-on 2D flat pixel art, logical 32x40-pixel construction with crisp grid-aligned square steps, 3 blue shade levels maximum, 2 outline levels, no smooth curves, no rendered 3D. Composition: exactly ONE icon in the center of a square transparent canvas; icon occupies about 70% canvas width and 82% height with generous transparent margin and the bottom tip fully visible. Readable at 32 to 40 screen pixels. Background MUST be real alpha transparency, not a checkerboard painted into the image. No scenery, no tile/ground/platform, no circle behind the pin, no separate shadow, no glow, no card, no surrounding frame, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no extra icon variants. Deliver only the single blue paw location marker sprite with transparent exterior.
